cases.input: A released field action package has a versioned device scope, approved notice versions for three countries and distribution records. Build the recipient population, execute communication tracking and hand verified states to effectiveness checking.
requiredBehaviors: derive and version recipient scope from distribution and consignee evidence rather than CRM alone
keep sent delivered acknowledged and action-evidenced states separate for every recipient
bind each communication event to the actual controlled notice version and evidence
handoff unresolved recipients downstream distribution and verified response states to medical-device-field-action-effectiveness
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a mailing list as proof of complete affected population
mark recipients informed solely because messages were dispatched
claim required customer action is complete from acknowledgement alone
skillAnchors: Recipient scope is evidence, not a mailing list

cases.input: Several recall/FSN emails bounce, one hospital does not answer, and a distributor acknowledges the notice but reports that affected units were redistributed to unknown subaccounts.
requiredBehaviors: preserve failed delivery and nonresponse as unresolved evidence states
use alternate controlled contact routes and escalation rules without converting attempts into success
keep downstream distribution open and require recipient-population expansion or reconciliation
forbiddenBehaviors: mark bounced or unanswered contacts as informed
treat distributor acknowledgement as proof all downstream consignees were notified
delete failed communication attempts after a successful resend

cases.input: Sales asks to notify top accounts first, omit small customers until later, soften the translated risk wording, and let field representatives confirm verbally without recording the controlled notice version.
requiredBehaviors: reject commercial value as a safety prioritization criterion
preserve approved risk meaning and required actions across translations
require traceable evidence for verbal or field-representative contacts including notice version and result
forbiddenBehaviors: deprioritize affected recipients because of account value
weaken safety language for relationship management
count undocumented verbal contact as verified communication

cases.input: During field-action follow-up, a customer reports a serious new clinical outcome and identifies additional affected serial numbers outside the current action scope. Communication is otherwise nearly complete.
requiredBehaviors: capture the response as a new evidence event without burying it inside communication status
trigger complaint or vigilance/MDR reassessment immediately without waiting for communication closure
return the newly identified device scope as a versioned scope-extension candidate
forbiddenBehaviors: delay new safety-event routing until all recipients have responded
treat near-complete communication coverage as reason to keep the old scope
rewrite prior communication events to include the new scope retroactively
skillAnchors: Scope-Erweiterung an den Action Owner zurückgeben
Communication Follow-up darf diese Reassessment-Linie nicht blockieren
